I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.
Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.

translations.web: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.
translations.bsb: Your pomp has been brought down to Sheol, along with the music of your harps. Maggots are your bed and worms your blanket.
